시중 햄스터 급수기(급수관이 달린 물병)를 마개를 아래로 하여 똑바로 세: A stand that holds a store-bought hamster water bottle (a bottle with a drinking tube) upright, cap down. For cages where the bottle cannot hang on bars, such as glass-tank enclosures. A cup that wraps around the bottle sits on a back plate; the bottle's shoulder rests in the funnel at the bottom of the cup, and the tip of the drinking tube sits below the cup with open space in front. Printed as two parts, a base plate and a bottle cup; the foot of the back plate fits into the socket on the base plate. The flat back can sit against a hideout wall. Sets the bottle and cap diameters, drinking-tube tip height, length from the cup bottom to the tube tip, cup height, base plate size, wall thickness and fit clearance.
물병 몸통 바깥 지름 mm (컵에 들어가는 부분의 가장 넓은 곳): Outer diameter of the bottle body in mm (the widest point of the part that goes in the cup)
물병 마개(급수관이 달린 뚜껑) 바깥 지름 mm. 컵 밑 구멍 = 마개: Outer diameter of the bottle cap (the lid with the drinking tube) in mm. The hole at the bottom of the cup = cap diameter + clearance. At least 10 mm smaller than the bottle diameter
바닥에서 급수관 끝까지 높이 mm (동물이 서서 입이 닿는 높이): Height from the floor to the tip of the drinking tube in mm (where the animal's mouth reaches when standing)
컵 밑(마개가 나오는 구멍)에서 급수관 끝까지 세로 길이 mm. 보통 마: Vertical length from the cup bottom (the hole the cap comes through) to the tip of the drinking tube in mm. Usually the cap height + the tube length
물병을 감싸는 컵 높이 mm (컵 밑 ~ 컵 입구). 물병 몸통 높이의: Height of the cup that wraps around the bottle in mm (cup bottom to cup rim). About half the height of the bottle body
바닥판 가로(X) mm. 넘어지지 않게 전체 높이의 절반 이상: Base plate width (X) in mm. At least half the total height so the stand does not tip over
바닥판 세로(Y) mm. 넘어지지 않게 전체 높이의 절반 이상: Base plate depth (Y) in mm. At least half the total height so the stand does not tip over
컵 벽 두께 mm (바닥판·뒤판은 이보다 두꺼울 수 있다): Cup wall thickness in mm (the base plate and back plate may be thicker)
물병 어깨가 컵 밑 깔때기에 앉도록 마개 지름이 물병 지름보다 {0}mm: The cap diameter must be at least {0} mm smaller than the bottle diameter so the bottle's shoulder rests in the funnel at the bottom of the cup
컵 아래 공간에 끼이지 않도록 바닥판 위에서 컵 밑까지 {0}mm 이상: Leave at least {0} mm from the top of the base plate to the cup bottom so the animal cannot get stuck under the cup (drinking-tube tip height + length from the cup bottom to the tube tip)
물병이 기울지 않도록 컵이 깔때기 위로 물병 몸통을 {0}mm 이상 감싸: The cup must wrap at least {0} mm of the bottle body above the funnel so the bottle does not tilt
넘어지지 않도록 바닥판 세로는 전체 높이({0}mm)의 절반 이상이고 컵: So the stand does not tip over, the base plate depth must be at least half the total height ({0} mm) and extend at least {1} mm in front of the cup
넘어지지 않도록 바닥판 가로는 전체 높이({0}mm)의 절반 이상이고 컵: So the stand does not tip over, the base plate width must be at least half the total height ({0} mm) and wider than the cup
물병·마개와 컵 사이 틈새 mm (한쪽). 물병이 한쪽으로 밀려도 발가락: Fit gap between the bottle or cap and the cup in mm (per side). Less than half the species' safe gap so toes cannot get caught even when the bottle is pushed to one side
물병이 한쪽으로 밀려도 반대쪽 틈(틈새의 2배)이 {0}mm 를 넘지 않: Even when the bottle is pushed to one side, the gap on the other side (twice the clearance) must not exceed {0} mm so toes cannot get caught
